verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness the chargers, snorting, rushing to battle before the others,
verse.verse_2: Then those striking sparks of fire,
verse.verse_3: Then those charging in the morning
verse.verse_6: That man is ungrateful to his Lord
verse.verse_7: And is himself witness to it,
verse.verse_8: And is intractable in his love of worldly goods.
verse.verse_9: Does he not know when the contents of the graves are laid bare
verse.verse_10: And the secrets of the hearts exposed,
verse.verse_11: Surely their Lord will be aware of their (deeds).
